title: Omi TV · v3

panels.title: Growth
panels.description: Users are deduplicated persons with qualified use (v2 definitions): a capture, conversation, chat or ≥2 successful MCP calls on a UTC day, not just an app open. Weekly, daily and monthly users over the trailing 7 / 1 / 30 complete UTC days (MCP-only included).
Growth: change vs the prior period, from the series API.

panels.title: Weekly users · by platform
panels.description: Users are deduplicated persons with qualified use (v2 definitions): a capture, conversation, chat or ≥2 successful MCP calls on a UTC day, not just an app open. Trailing 7-day periods ending each date (UTC), stacked by each user's primary platform. Starts at the first period after mobile telemetry began (week of 2026-05-04); earlier periods undercount mobile and are not drawn. MCP-only = users whose only qualified use was ≥2 successful MCP calls on a day (blank before that marker existed). The latest bar is the weekly-users stat.

panels.title: New, returning & lost users
panels.description: Each week's active users = returning (also active the prior 7 days) + back after a break + new (first seen this week). Lost = last week's users not active this week, drawn below zero.

panels.title: Quick ratio
panels.description: Users gained ÷ users lost each week: (new + back after a break) ÷ lost. Above 1.0 the active base is growing.

panels.title: Stickiness (DAU/WAU)
panels.description: Average daily users ÷ weekly users: qualified user-days in the 7-day period ÷ (7 × weekly users). 100% = every weekly user is active every day.

panels.title: Activation
panels.description: Week-one activation: new users (first seen in the weekly cohort, 180-day lookback so returning users are not counted as new) with ≥2 qualified days in days 1–7. Saved capture: share of the same cohort with a saved own-device or mic capture in week one, the main activation driver. Change in percentage points vs the prior weekly cohort.
Activation: change vs the prior period, from the series API.

panels.title: Activation · by platform
panels.description: Week-one activation for weekly new-user cohorts, dated by the cohort's last day, split by the platform users first arrived on. Rates use the full cohort, including users who never qualified. The latest point is the stat.

panels.title: Saved capture · week one
panels.description: Share of each new-user cohort with a saved, non-discarded own-device or mic conversation in days 1–7, by first platform. The latest point is the stat.

panels.title: Activation by capture source
panels.description: Latest matured new-user cohort (the activation stat's cohort), split by what users captured with in week one: an Omi pendant, several devices, Limitless, Apple Watch, another device, phone mic and/or Mac, or nothing saved. Bars are each group's week-one activation; the group size is in the label. Groups sum to the cohort.

panels.title: Retention
panels.description: Retained if activated: activated new users who qualify again in days 8–37. Established: users active in both of the prior two weeks who are active this week. Change in percentage points vs the prior cohort / week.
Retention: change vs the prior period, from the series API.

panels.title: Weekly cohort retention · W0–W8
panels.description: Share of each weekly new-user cohort (180-day history check, as the activation stat) with a qualified day in week k after first seen. Only fully observed weeks are drawn; darker = older cohort.

panels.title: Retention · weekly
panels.description: Established retention by week (solid) and retained-if-activated by the cohort's last first-seen day (dashed). Latest points are the stats.

panels.title: Power users · days active
panels.description: Share of weekly users by number of active days in the latest 7 days, against the same period 4 weeks earlier. A rise on the right means habitual use.

panels.title: Revenue
panels.description: MRR: live Stripe Omi-plan book (change = same-source FinOps 7-day change). Revenue per user = MRR ÷ monthly users (qualified MAU; change vs prior week). Hardware: Shopify net device sales, last complete Mon–Sun week vs the prior week. Relative % change.
Revenue: change vs the prior period, from the series API.

panels.title: MRR · by plan
panels.description: Unlimited includes Neo. Daily FinOps snapshots of the Stripe plan book (deduplicated by snapshot date; known gaps: an unmapped enterprise price and two JPY subscriptions). The final point is the live Stripe book, the MRR stat. Shopify plan prepay is cash and never included.

panels.title: Revenue per user (ARPMAU)
panels.description: Omi-plan MRR ÷ monthly users (qualified MAU: 30 days, MCP-inclusive) at each week end. History uses the FinOps book; the latest point is the stat. MAU here is qualified MAU (~10K). The "Omi Cost vs Revenue" artifact divides by any-event PostHog MAU (~22K, $3.41 in October), so its per-user cost is about half of this one.

panels.title: Shopify sales · weekly
panels.description: Net device sales (refunds restate their sale week, no tax/shipping) and Omi Unlimited plan prepay cash (reported separately, never MRR). Device units in the tooltip.

panels.title: Health
panels.description: All-in cost counts every line: GCP net of committed-use credits (one-time incidents excluded), Vertex/Gemini LLM, OpenAI and Anthropic invoices, STT and SaaS. STT has no invoice feed yet: it is a $5.3K/month estimate from the Soniox console (October 2026, read 2026-10-16; the FinOps stt_vendor_low model overstated it ~2×). SaaS is a fixed $4.8K/month estimate. Cost / day is the settled day D−2; cost per user is the 30-day all-in cost ÷ monthly users. MAU here is qualified MAU (~10K). The "Omi Cost vs Revenue" artifact divides by any-event PostHog MAU (~22K, $3.41 in October), so its per-user cost is about half of this one. Relative % change; up is bad.
Health: change vs the prior period, from the series API.

panels.title: All-in cost vs revenue
panels.description: All-in cost counts every line: GCP net of committed-use credits (one-time incidents excluded), Vertex/Gemini LLM, OpenAI and Anthropic invoices, STT and SaaS. STT has no invoice feed yet: it is a $5.3K/month estimate from the Soniox console (October 2026, read 2026-10-16; the FinOps stt_vendor_low model overstated it ~2×). SaaS is a fixed $4.8K/month estimate. Settled through D−2. Invoiced lines are the solid blue-greys; STT est. (Soniox console) and SaaS est. (fixed) are the amber segments. The stack top is the cost stat. One-time GCP spikes (a service-day above 2× and $500 over its 14-day median, e.g. the 2026-09-07 Coldline migration) are excluded and shown in the tooltip. Revenue = FinOps MRR ÷ 30.4.

panels.title: Cost per user · 30d
panels.description: All-in 30-day cost through D−2 ÷ the same window's monthly users. MAU here is qualified MAU (~10K). The "Omi Cost vs Revenue" artifact divides by any-event PostHog MAU (~22K, $3.41 in October), so its per-user cost is about half of this one. Dashed: the cost per user at which blended margin reaches the 60% goal (0.4 × revenue per user), a sizing guide rather than the contract margin.

panels.title: Data & coverage
panels.description: First row: the oldest series' data-through day (UTC) across every chart, and how many series are still filling; the board shows stale-but-real data rather than waiting. Below: wall metrics without a defensible source (2026-10-15 contract audit). They stay off the charts rather than showing empty panels or fake zeros. The route's full classified reason is in /api/omi/stats/wall/series/headline (gaps[].reason) and the v2 diagnostics.

description: Growth → Activation → Retention → Revenue → Health. Stats above native charts; v2 metric definitions via /api/omi/stats/wall/series. Every chart's latest point is the stat above it. Data-through day and missing sources are listed under Data & coverage.
